AttributeList.Text: Calculates the actual tension based on the drive torque

LineComment.Text: Comment/Function: This function blocks calculates the actual web tension based on the actual torque of the drive
Version | Date | Expert in charge | Changes applied

Comment.MultiLanguageText:
The function block calculates the current web tension based on the actual torque of the drive, the gear ratio and the current diameter. For the best calculation results, the disturbances comming from acceleration and friction effects must be pre controlled and the torque pre control value must be forwarded to the function block. The funtion block calculates the tension torque based on the following formula:
$ TensionTorque = (actualTorque - torquePreControl) * \frac{gearRatio}{radius}\ $
